name: EdZooCrew Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Teens work in the animal yards of the Children's Zoo. They do face painting and crafts. They help at events, classes, camps and parties.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 17. Commit to 40 hours or more a year.
pay_detail: Volunteer, unpaid. A discount on zoo food and retail items is listed.
duration: At least 40 hours a year, flexible schedule
deadline_text: Applications are accepted year-round. Training sessions run monthly from March through June.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Teen Volunteer Application linked on the page. Then go to one training before you start. Contact: bmoore@eriezoo.org, 814-864-4091 ext. 1125.
notes: Volunteers get a discount on food and retail items, per the Why Volunteer section. Training is offered monthly March to June.
